policy_name: Care Advantage + add-ons (Protect Plus + Care Shield)

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured. Air ambulance up to Rs 5 lakhs as optional cover.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Automatic recharge up to SI; available for unrelated or same illness. Unlimited recharge optional.

room_rent_capping: No sub-limit; single private room category as optional add-on.
copayment_trigger_notes: 20% co-payment for age 61 and above (optional cover) and for non-listed hospitals under Smart Select.

worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Protect Plus add-on offers global coverage excluding USA/Canada/India for planned hospitalization; option for worldwide ex-India incl. emergency.

available_riders: Care Advanced (Claim Shield, NCB Shield, Inflation Shield)
